partner_applied.application: Use J3>=Z3/2 in the double-heavy third-volume collar, then apply QFORM-VOLUME-STABILITY-OPTIMAL-Q-v1 to the new low-rank physical decomposition M=M0+E.

new_results: QFORM-ANCHORED-COMPOUND-NORMAL-FORM-v1: for M=[[a,r^T],[c,N]], anchored compounds satisfy J_{k+1}=a^2 e_k((N-cr^T/a)^T(N-cr^T/a)) when a!=0; when a=0, J_{k+1}=||c||^2||r||^2 e_{k-1}(K^T K), K=P_{c^perp}NP_{r^perp}.
QFORM-COMPOUND-GAP-RANK-COLLAPSE-v1: e_{m+2}/e_m >= x_{m+1}x_{m+2}/binom(m+2,2) for decreasing nonnegative x with e_m>0.
QFORM-JOINT-STAR-D5-LOWRANK-v1: double-heavy third-volume plus weak fifth volume gives s4(S)<=(12Z5/Z3)^(1/4) for a!=0, or s3(K)<=(6Z5/Z3)^(1/4) for a=0.

If the resulting physical low-rank core M0 has leverage<=1/2 and s3(M0)>=16||M-M0||op, account02/B02 stability yields integral|phi_Q|<95.799/s3(M0) and ||p_Q||inf<15.247/s3(M0), with continuous density.
unresolved_implication: QFORM-JOINT-STAR-HIGH-LEVERAGE-OR-THIRD-SINGULAR-CLOSURE-v1: route the high-leverage core or core with s3 at the tail scale into existing original-coordinate pair/triple, hub, ridge, grouped-bank, mixed-bilinear, or scalar-Schur mechanisms.
